check_box.name: diopter_enabled
check_box.label: Enable Ultimate Diopter
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch. When off the effect allocates no render targets and adds no draw calls.

combo_box.name: diopter_tool_mode
combo_box.label: Tool Mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Switches the post pass between the Ultimate Diopter (lens-front glass/halo) and the Ultimate Kaleidoscope (fold patterns). Both share this floater's master enable and render target; only one runs at a time.

combo_box.name: diopter_preset
combo_box.label: Preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Sets the optical character. Framing (position, size, focus, angle) stays on your sliders.

combo_box.name: diopter_placement
combo_box.label: Placement
combo_box.tool_tip: Framed: a placed glass element with a visible boundary. On-lens: the whole frame sits behind the filter and the center only sets the optical axis. In on-lens mode the Size slider and Contents combo are inert; size-targeted motion (Pulse: Size, Stutter Size) breathes the falloff reach instead.

combo_box.name: kal_preset
combo_box.label: Preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Sets the fold pattern and motion character. Framing (center, protect center), Blend, Setup View and Freeze stay on your sliders.

slider.name: kal_seam_soften
slider.label: Seam Soften
slider.tool_tip: Feathers the mirror seams (Radial Mirror pattern only).

combo_box.name: kal_protect_mode
combo_box.label: Protect Mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Holds the untouched subject over the kaleidoscope.
